newsitem.title: USA: Chile's ENAP buys Palanca, Oriente crudes for Aug.
newsitem.headline: Chile's ENAP buys Palanca, Oriente crudes for Aug.

text.p: Chile's state oil refiner Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought Angolan Palanca and Ecuadoran Oriente crude cargoes in its latest purchase tender, trade sources said on Thursday.
The cargoes will be delivered around August 10-14.
ENAP purchased the 950,000 barrel Palanca cargo from a European company at an undisclosed price, trade sources said.
The Chilean company bought the 380,000 barrel Oriente cargo from an Ecuadoran trading house at around 15 cents over the Oriente price formula for Chilean customers.

The Chilean formula, which was revised up last month by 30 cents a barrel along with the other Oriente formulas, is currently $5.18 a barrel under benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, the sources said.
